newsitem.title: ITALY: Pagnossin stock healthy but analysts wary.
newsitem.headline: Pagnossin stock healthy but analysts wary.

text.p: Shares in Italian ceramics group La Pagnossin SpA performed well on the Milan bourse on Tuesday after a meeting with analysts, but some remain cautious about room for more gains after sharp falls last week.
Pagnossin, which was listed only in December, was quoted at 5,650 lire, up 150 lire, near the close in good volume. The stock, however, touched a year's low of 5,450 on October 7.
The company posted first half 1996 consolidated net profit of 3.6 billion lire against 2.3 billion in the same 1995 period.

"Sentiment is fairly positive given that margins have held despite the fact that the lira and economic situation should in theory penalise such manufacturing sectors," said an analyst at Pasfin brokers. "But we're not going beyond a 'hold'," he said.
"The feeling is that you risk relatively little buying at current price levels," said one analyst who declined to be named.

"I've had a 'reduce' on the stock for three months or so and I think I'll keep it," said Elisabetta Villa of AFV brokers. "Such small companies are interesting if rates of growth are particularly high."
During the analysts' meeting on Monday, Pagnossin expressed its wish to expand through acquisitions and confirmed its expectations for profits in line with the first half.
